sentence: Among high-tech ventures, revenue reacts only once AI adoption passes a sufficient intensity, and the gains grow where the venture also runs complementary technologies, cloud services and databases among them, and keeps R&D inside the venture
passage: [Lee et al. (2022), p. 1] "This paper examines how high-tech venture performance varies with AI-adoption intensity." / "We find that firm revenue increases only after sufficient investment in AI, and the benefits of AI adoption are greater at firms that also invest in complementary technologies and pursue internal R&D strategy." / "We find that such performance gains from adoption is larger among firms that invest in complementary technologies such as cloud computing and database systems."

gemini.note: The passage's stated findings explicitly confirm all elements of the sentence, including the investment threshold, the specific complementary technologies, and the internal R&D requirement.
